physicalEvidence.summary: December 2024 primary methods deploy SAC-trained three-layer networks onboard Source One and Impulse Micro quadrotors. The policy selects maneuver trigger and angular acceleration; subsequent rotation/attachment follows staged control. Vicon at100Hz supplies state and emulated optical-flow variables; fully onboard visual sensing is future work. Physical tests cover five steel-surface orientations using magnetic footpads, with wall-landing discrepancies disclosed. Some scale and damping comparisons remain simulated. This is own-group Penn State execution, but the experiments were already in the 2024 version, not newly performed for the 2026 news feature.
